blocks.text: Testing and debugging are essential to ensure applications work correctly under all conditions. They help detect and remove errors before the software is released. Regular testing prevents unexpected failures during operation. Debugging locates the cause of errors and fixes them efficiently. Together, these practices increase reliability and user confidence.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Discuss scenarios where errors cause failure, and explain testing importance.
